inventory.name: Mastercrafted Piercing Dagger
inventory.effect: Armor-Piercing, +1 STK when used against a model in Crouched State.

stratagems.name: Exploiting Weakness
stratagems.effect: Unsuccessful Damage Rolls against target model may be rerolled once.

stratagems.name: Guerrilla Tactics
stratagems.effect: Assassins and Rogues gain the Hit and Retreat and Backstab skills.

stratagems.name: Mastery of Poisons
stratagems.effect: Attacks of Assassins and Rogues gain the Poison I Trait. Affected models that already have these, receive the Poison II Trait instead.

stratagems.name: Swift Retreat
stratagems.effect: During the End Phase when in the Active Role, Assassins and Rogues may perform a Normal Movement.
